title: Free plan limits, and the blacklist joins Premium
changes: The blacklist system is now part of Premium. If your server already has it turned on it keeps working and nothing changes for you. This only affects servers switching it on for the first time
The free plan now covers 100 shop items, 5 civilian jobs and 5 requestable roles. If you already have more than that you keep every one of them, you just cannot add new ones without Premium
Every limit now offers the 7 day free trial on a button instead of sending you to a price list. Press it and everything unlocks right away, no card and no signup
/premium now starts the free trial from a button, and lists what you actually get
